paper.title_en: Crossover from Schwarzian dynamics to rotational soft modes in near-extremal Lovelock black holes
paper.abstract_en: Near-extremal black holes are controlled by a small set of soft modes, and counting these modes fixes the coefficient of $\log T$ in the entropy. We ask whether genuine six-derivative interactions change that count, working in seven-dimensional third-order Lovelock gravity, the simplest setting where the cubic Lovelock term is dynamical. The multiplicities stay the same, but the naive count fails. At fixed charge the Maxwell mode is frozen out, and the fifteen rotational modes of the $S^5$ act as a quantum rotor that only switches on above the scale $K_J^{-1}$. As a result, the coefficient of $\log T$ runs from $3/2$ at the lowest temperatures to $9$ above that scale, and never reaches the naive Gaussian value $19/2$. We compute the moment of inertia $K_J$ from the charged slow-rotation solution and find that the Lovelock couplings move the crossover without changing the multiplicities. Only large AdS black holes have a wide window in which the full rotational contribution competes with the classical entropy. Adding a probe charged scalar, we derive an analytic near-horizon Schwinger threshold in the cubic coupling. Its large-AdS limit tells us when the broad rotational crossover window can coexist with the absence of a charged-scalar Breitenlohner--Freedman (BF) bound violation.

decision.title_zh: 近极端Lovelock黑洞中从Schwarzian动力学到转动软模的交叉
decision.abstract_zh: 近极端黑洞由少量软模主导，而这些模的计数确定了熵中$\log T$的系数。我们在七维三阶Lovelock引力中——即三次Lovelock项为动力学变量的最简单设定——追问真正的六导数相互作用是否会改变这一计数。多重数保持不变，但朴素的计数失效。在固定电荷下，Maxwell模被冻结，而$S^5$的十五个转动模作为量子转子，只有在$K_J^{-1}$尺度以上才开启。结果是，$\log T$的系数从最低温度下的$3/2$变化到该尺度以上的$9$，并且永远达不到朴素的高斯值$19/2$。我们由带电慢转动解计算转动惯量$K_J$，发现Lovelock耦合会移动该交叉而不改变多重数。只有大的AdS黑洞才具有完整转动贡献与经典熵相竞争的宽窗口。加入一个探针带电标量后，我们导出了三次耦合下解析的近视界Schwinger阈值。其大AdS极限告诉我们，宽的转动交叉窗口何时能与带电标量Breitenlohner--Freedman (BF) 界不被违反共存。
